arStrings.szText: Belial escaped. (sighs) His presence in Sanctuary is already too deeply rooted.
We were too late to banish him, but it wasn't all for naught.
When the connection was made, I felt Belial's fear. He knows we can still thwart his plan.
We can still prevent him from drawing all of Sanctuary into the Realm of Lies. But I need more time to sort our next steps.
You must continue destroying his Apparitions. Enhance your powers. Do that, then meet me at my shop again.
